function relocate_zone_blocked_work_geometry!(env)
    zone_keys = [first(zone) for zone in active_restriction_zones()]
    blockage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)

    if blockage.n_blocked != 0
        restaged = restage_all_blocked!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, resume = false, verbose = false)
        blockage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)

        if !(restaged.status in (:restaged_all, :none)) || blockage.n_blocked != 0
            if blockage.n_blocked != 0
                translated = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, resume = false, verbose = false)
                blockage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)

                if !(translated.status in (:translated, :already_clear)) && blockage.n_blocked != 0
                    error("scene-tree relocation failed to clear all required navigation goals")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    blockage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    blockage.n_blocked == 0 || error("scene-tree relocation left blocked unfinished navigation goals")
    return (; status = :success)
end
